lots.guide_summary: 13 surviving entries, all SOLD (0 unsold, 0 asking), from the PriceCharting PAL console pages (eBay sales, mostly UK/EU, USD converted at 1 USD = 1.438252 AUD). Per console: SNES AUD 48 to 74, Mega Drive II AUD 13 to 133, Master System II AUD 13 to 119. For the lot of four, guide_low = sum of the lowest per console (48.05 + 2 x 13.49 + 13.35 = AUD 88) and guide_high = sum of the highest (74.39 + 2 x 133.28 + 119.10 = AUD 460). PriceCharting's loose averages on the same pages: SNES US$73.20, Mega Drive II US$69.00, Master System II US$59.93 (category guide only).
lots.working: Rate 1 USD = 1.438252 AUD. KEEP: lowest same-item SOLD per console: SNES 48.05 + Mega Drive II 13.49 x 2 + Master System II 13.35 = AUD 88.38; 88.38 / 1.198 = 73.77, rounded down to $70. FLIP: likely resale as four separate untested console-only listings using medians of the surviving sales: SNES 57.16 (median of 48.05, 57.16, 74.39), Mega Drive II 58.31 each (median of 13.49, 37.25, 58.15, 58.47, 99.73, 133.28) x 2 = 116.62, Master System II 57.45 (median of 13.35, 37.83, 77.06, 119.10); total AUD 231.23. Less eBay AU fees about 13.4% = 30.99 and outbound postage about $15 x 4 = 60, net 140.24; 140.24 / 2.396 = 58.53, rounded down to $55. Gowans premium 19.8%, pickup Moonah, inbound freight $0. Lot already has 10 bids, so it may already be near these limits.
lots.confidence_reason: All four consoles positively identified from labels in the photos (MEGA DRIVE II, MASTER SYSTEM II POWER BASE, SUPER NINTENDO PAL VERSION). SOLD prices come from an opened aggregator page with dated individual sales, but the eBay item pages could not be opened, sales are mostly overseas and many titles do not state condition; the consoles are untested.
lots.dropped_entries: Researcher supplied no entries. From the PriceCharting pages I left out: SNES Mini Classic sales (different product); boxed or bundled sales with controllers, leads or games (not comparable to bare untested consoles); a 'Broken Super Nintendo Console' at US$25.84 (known broken, worse than untested).
lots.key_photo_findings: Photo 1: box with a Mega Drive II (top left), a second Mega Drive II on its side (partial view), a Master System II with POWER BASE label, and a grey SNES whose cartridge slot reads PAL VERSION with Nintendo SUPER NINTENDO ENTERTAINMENT SYSTEM logo. Photo 2: close-up of one Mega Drive II with a yellow sticker 'This electrical article has not been electrically tested to ensure that it can be safely operated', some scuffs and a residue mark at right. No cables, pads or games visible.
lots.condition: Untested, as is. Cosmetic scuffs and some dirt; second Mega Drive II only partly seen. No accessories visible.
lots.question_for_gowans: Are any power supplies, AV or RF leads, controllers or games in the box? Have any of the four consoles been powered on? Is the second Mega Drive II complete (no cracks, cartridge flap intact)?
